title: Stormline Express
brief: Repair track and radio faults, manage boiler pressure, collect supplies and rescue passengers along a storm route.
players: 1–4 LAN cooperative players; local solo campaign

chapters.title: The Broken Signal
chapters.story: Ada takes the relief train into a storm after the town radio goes quiet.

chapters.title: Pressure and Rain
chapters.story: Bo counts stranded passengers while the boiler leaks and the rails begin to buckle.

chapters.title: The Last Platform
chapters.story: Lark lights the final platform. The crew must bring both train and people through the storm.

status: development; build, gameplay, physical controller, multi-machine LAN and Steam release acceptance tracked separately
inspiration: Original characters, names, story and code; genre references are design inspiration only.
